name: @canvist/headless
description: canvist's document model and editing engine with no DOM: ProseMirror JSON, HTML, and Markdown conversion, typed commands, Yjs collaboration, and server-side rendering for Node, Deno, Bun, and Workers.

scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:document && npm run build:wasm:full && npm run build:wasm:scene && npm run build:wasm:ssr
scripts.build:wasm:document: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/canvist_headless_wasm --target web --profile wasm-release --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-headless/wasm --no-pack && rm packages/canvist-headless/wasm/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:full: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/canvist_headless_wasm --target web --profile wasm-release --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-headless/wasm-full --out-name canvist_headless_full --no-pack -- --features full && rm packages/canvist-headless/wasm-full/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:scene: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/canvist_headless_wasm --target web --profile wasm-release --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-headless/wasm-scene --out-name canvist_headless_scene --no-pack -- --features scene && rm packages/canvist-headless/wasm-scene/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:ssr: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/canvist_headless_wasm --target web --profile wasm-release --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-headless/wasm-ssr --out-name canvist_headless_ssr --no-pack -- --features ssr && rm packages/canvist-headless/wasm-ssr/.gitignore
